text:
8. 1. 2. 7

Purisabandhana suttaṃ

(Sāvatthi nidānaṃ)

Aṭṭhahi bhikkhave ākārehi itthi purisaṃ bandhati, katamehi aṭṭhahi: rūpena bhikkhave, itthi purisaṃ bandhati, hasitena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati, bhaṇitena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati. Gītena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati. . ruṇṇena. Bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati, ākappena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ

Bandhati. Vanabhaṅgena bhikkhave, itthī purisaṃ bandhati. Phassena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati. Imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi ākārehi itthi purisaṃ bandhati. Te bhikkhave sattā subaddhā ye phassena baddhāti. 3*
